Cozy Mystery · Channel 5 · 2023–present

The Good Ship Murder

3 Series 2 Christmas Specials Shayne Ward & Catherine Tyldesley Mediterranean Cruise A New Port Each Episode

Shayne Ward stars as Jack Grayling, a former police detective turned cruise ship singer, who solves murders with First Officer Kate Woods (Catherine Tyldesley) as their ship sails around the Mediterranean. Created by Paul Matthew Thompson and Mike Benson, The Good Ship Murder has run for three series plus two Christmas specials on Channel 5 since 2023, and a fourth series has been announced. It streams on BritBox in the US. See how the services compare in British TV Hub's guide to where to watch British TV in the US.

Setting and Filming Locations

Setting & Filming

A Mediterranean Cruise

The story follows a cruise ship around the Mediterranean and beyond. Filming has taken place aboard the cruise ship MSC Virtuosa, with much of the production based in Malta.
